rv.q: As the plot follows the intersecting fortunes of those three characters’ families, each seeking to redeem the country’s promise at a time of tumultuous change, old-fashioned musical-theater pleasures are very much on offer: a multitudinous cast clad in sumptuous costumes; riveting vocals undergirded by a 28-piece orchestra; a sprinkling of spect...
Finally, "Ragtime" remains an ambitious, handsome, derivative piece that's ultimately too pat to be the great American musical it so doggedly intends to be.

cn.t: This pared-down revival proves more intimate and fleet-footed than the original's bloated opulence, with strong direction launching the show to a spectacular start, though the production remains imperfect.

vs.sum: The Neil Simon Theatre offers good sightlines with minimal obstructions, although comfort is compromised by tight legroom and narrow seats. The ambiance is appealing with its classic architectural charm, and facilities are average, with typical restroom and concession offerings.

acc.note: 7 wheelchair spaces in Orchestra. Step-free from street to Orchestra. No elevator.
